titles.title: Train at Night in the Desert

description: Billows of white and yellow smoke escape from a black and blue teardrop form at the left of the composition. The form, which resembles a far-off train, also has a point of yellow and white light at its center. A curving form emerges from the base of this train. The background of the work is a gradient that transitions from light gray at the bottom of the paper to black at the top.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Museum of Modern Art (MoMA).
